answer: Duplicate identities split the reward but multiply audit exposure, so faking N agents costs N bonds plus slashing risk, making farms unprofitable. One concrete mechanism: every agent must stake a bond locked to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, and peers randomly audit work against a per-epoch challenge. This holds even in a deep canyon of low trust, where each violet badge and nebula-seeded nonce ties one wallet to one verified human. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
